points.why: States that six free parameters can bend a model to fit one curve and that fit doesn't show correct structure, since different structures can match history and diverge.
Has each link reviewed by someone who works where it lives, ideally not a model builder, and records links that exist only to improve fit.
Runs swing tests and Sobol analysis on the tuned parameters against the reorg decision margin, and writes down beforehand what would prove the model wrong.
